| γ_true | 条件 | γ_bias | γ_RMSE | CI95% coverage | θ_corr |
|--------|------|--------|--------|----------------|--------|
| 2.0 | 4 条件 | 0.005~0.034 | 0.09~0.12 | **1.00** | 0.95~0.97 |
| 4.0 | 4 条件 | -0.23~0.04 | 0.18~0.29 | **0.90** | 0.91~0.96 |
